{"key":"req-0001","response":{"candidates":[{"content":{"parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Variance-Adaptive LBD Restarting Implementation\n\n  // Access current EMAs for LBD (Glue)\n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 1: Augment solver state to track lbd_variance\n  // Since we cannot modify the 'kissat' struct, we use a static variable.\n  // We approximate the 'squared deviation of current LBD from fast_lbd_ema'\n  // using the deviation of the 'fast' EMA from the 'slow' EMA, as the \n  // instantaneous LBD is not directly exposed in the solver state.\n  static double lbd_variance = 0.0;\n\n  // Calculate squared deviation proxy\n  double deviation = fast - slow;\n  double sq_deviation = deviation * deviation;\n\n  // Update EMA with alpha = 0.05\n  lbd_variance = 0.95 * lbd_variance + 0.05 * sq_deviation;\n\n  // Step 2: Calculate Coefficient of Variation (CV)\n  double cv = sqrt (lbd_variance) / (slow + 1e-9);\n\n  // Step 3: Determine threshold scaler S\n  double S = 1.0;\n  if (cv \u003e 0.5)\n    S = 1.15; // High volatility: suppress restarts\n  else if (cv \u003c 0.15)\n    S = 0.85; // Low volatility: encourage restarts\n\n  // Step 4: Trigger restart if fast_lbd_ema \u003e slow_lbd_ema * S\n  double limit = slow * S;\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart params: fast=%g slow=%g cv=%g S=%g limit=%g\",\n                            fast, slow, cv, S, limit);\n\n  return (fast \u003e limit);\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"citationMetadata":{"citationSources":[{"uri":"https://github.com/ChunxiaoIanLi/RL_reset","license":"","endIndex":314,"startIndex":7}]},"index":0,"finishReason":"STOP"}],"responseId":"B9OKad6gB42k_uMP_c7wsA8","usageMetadata":{"candidatesTokenCount":528,"promptTokenCount":5857,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5857,"modality":"TEXT"}],"totalTokenCount":18411,"thoughtsTokenCount":12026},"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview"},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
